Slots live in board.json now — surface them in the report's fleet line (slot a vs slot b attribution per merge). Extend shiftr

issues.title: QA — platform: watch.sh live pane for slot b (per-slot tap streams)
issues.body: Carried from #1266 item 3 (items 1-2 ship in the fleet-followups PR): `watch.sh --live` gives BUILDER a tap-stream pane; slot b (QA·STUDIO on :8000) deserves one too. Needs a second tap instance (e.g. :8011 -> :8000, out /tmp/forge/stream-studio.log) as a launchd job, forge-qa.sh studio routing thro

issues.title: PLATFORM: harden the forge watch dashboard — lane panes never vanish
issues.body: On Oct 30 the BUILDER pane in `scripts/watch.sh --live` closed by itself and the LIVE pane took over the top row. Cause unknown: its redraw loop just ended. A lane pane should never disappear.

issues.body: Plan: Forge × Plaicraft voiced co-op (Jon's doc, Oct 30). Needs #1247; build after the co-op kitchen (#1248).

issues.title: GAME: BOMB DEFUSE — one sees the bomb, one holds the manual
issues.body: Plan: Forge × Plaicraft voiced co-op (Jon's doc, Oct 30). Needs #1247; build after the co-op kitchen (#1248).

issues.title: GAME: RALLY CO-DRIVER — one calls pace notes, one drives
issues.body: Plan: Forge × Plaicraft voiced co-op (Jon's doc, Oct 30). Needs #1247; build after the co-op kitchen (#1248).

issues.title: PLATFORM: Gauntlet — model in a slot follows a spoken call
issues.body: Plan: Forge × Plaicraft voiced co-op (Jon's doc, Oct 30). Needs #1247.

issues.title: GAME: original co-op kitchen (Overcooked-style) — voice on from day one
issues.body: Plan: Forge × Plaicraft voiced co-op (Jon's doc, Oct 30). Needs #1247.

issues.title: DEMO: LEARNED WALK — the same body, but it learns to walk (Qwen alone)
issues.body: From Jon: the third rung after STICK WALK (IK) and PHYSICS WALK (#1204). Same body, same physics, but no hand-written balance controller. Train one with RL on the local machines, then ship the trained policy in the browser.

issues.title: GAME: FLOOR BOSS — robot warehouse sim
issues.body: Needs #1141 (robot sim kit). An original management sim on the robot sim kit. You run a warehouse floor: robot arms, mobile robots, racks and conveyors. Lay out the floor, then dispatch robots as orders pour in. Jams, breakdowns and rush hours keep it busy. Think SimCity or a theme-park sim, but for

issues.title: PLATFORM: robot sim kit (SimReady assets, physics, Plaicraft episodes)
issues.body: Build one shared robot sim kit that three new games will run on (#1142, #1143, #1144). Improving the kit should lift all three.

issues.title: GAME: Wizardry-style crawler, same rules, our own world
issues.body: Keep Wizardry exactly as it played in 1981. That means rolling a party of six (races, classes, alignment), the training grounds, tavern and temple, spells by level, turn-based group combat, a ten-floor maze you map yourself, and death and resurrection. The rules don't change.

issues.title: MYST: bring it much closer to the 1993 original — one Age at a time
issues.body: Myst works end to end but is thin: 14 nodes total, each Age is a single view with one gate puzzle (see the README's honest gaps).

issues.title: FORGE PULSE
issues.body: Machine-updated status line for https://jalfern.com/retrogames/forge — do not close.

issues.title: PLATFORM — in-game feedback button: note + screenshot + state + last-30s replay, filed via the relay
issues.body: From Jon: a feedback button on every game and demo, so playing and QA happen in one motion. First user is Jon; friends come later.

issues.title: Platform: map all PS4/standard pad buttons per game; check every action is reachable
issues.body: **Lane:** platform (SSX is the first user)

issues.title: PLATFORM: Studio runs 2 builders + 1 QA — every lane works the whole queue
issues.body: From Jon: everyone should be trying to do the work.

issues.title: PLATFORM: voice capture in recordings (raw audio per player, on the frame clock)
issues.body: Plan: Forge × Plaicraft voiced co-op (Jon's doc, Oct 30). Do this first: everything else in the plan needs it.

issues.title: DEMO: PHYSICS WALK — a stick figure that walks with real physics (Qwen alone)
issues.body: From Jon: the next step up from STICK WALK. STICK WALK (#1150) computes poses directly with IK. This one should be closer to real physics: a 3D body with mass, joints and motors that has to balance and walk on its own. Tap or click to push him, and he stumbles and recovers or falls. Keep STICK WALK

issues.title: PLATFORM: forge runway — "N days of queued work left"
issues.body: From Jon: I want to know what we're running against. Put a runway number at the top of the forge dashboard (https://jalfern.com/retrogames/forge), something like "Builder: ~2.5 days queued · QA: ~0.5 day".

issues.title: DEMO — STICK WALK: a 3D mocap-style stick figure walking (Qwen alone)
issues.body: New demo, Qwen alone. A 3D stick figure that walks.

issues.title: GAME: PICK RUSH — robot arm at the conveyor
issues.body: Needs #1141 (robot sim kit). An original arcade game on the robot sim kit. A robot arm stands at a conveyor. Grab items as they pass and drop them in the right bins before the shift ends. Speed increases, odd shapes turn up, and some items are fragile.

issues.title: PLATFORM: shared 3D model index (link, don't download)
issues.body: Build a shared index of free 3D models that any game or demo can pull from. Don't mirror the libraries. Keep a link list in the repo (source, what it has, license, format), and pull in only the models a game actually uses, converted to GLB and sized for iPhone.

issues.title: PLATFORM: before/after film strips on every visual PR
issues.body: Every PR that changes how a game looks gets a before/after film strip: the same seeded replay, stepped through the game contract, rendered on main and on the branch, with matching frames side by side. Attach it to the PR and link it from the shift report.

issues.title: PLATFORM: boredom map — where games go flat, spike or stall
issues.body: Build on the nightly bot runs (#1040). Play each game's bot over many seeds and chart how much is happening each second: events, enemies on screen, damage, score.

issues.title: GAME: BRITANNIA — Ultima IV rebuilt from scratch (long run)
issues.body: Rebuild Ultima IV from scratch as a new game: no emulator. Play it the way the original plays: the same world, towns, conversations, eight virtues, combat, dungeons and ending. Every graphic and sound is new, built to the MODERN bar.

issues.title: PLATFORM — help and title screens carry more text than fits on screen (all games and demos)
issues.body: From Jon: our help screens generally have more info than we can easily display. Examples: Magic Carpet's title screen runs 5 lines of rules over the game and into the HUD; Black Hole's caption grows into a column covering a third of the screen (#1097); captions on several demos ran under the BUILT B

issues.title: GAME: original gritty fighter in the spirit of Mortal Kombat (own IP), on the shared fighting engine
issues.body: From Jon: our own Mortal Kombat-style fighter. Original name, roster and stages; no Midway/NetherRealm characters, names or moves.

issues.title: GAME: original 2D fighter in the spirit of classic Street Fighter (own IP) + shared fighting engine
issues.body: From Jon: a classic one-on-one fighter, our own IP. Original name, roster and stages; no Capcom characters, names or moves.

issues.title: MAGIC CARPET HD — new 3D renderer, built fresh (not a patch)
issues.body: #1059 changed the rules but kept the old renderer, so the game looks exactly the same as before. This one is about the look.

issues.title: PLATFORM — jalfern.com serves stale game pages after deploys (Magic Carpet rebuild invisible)
issues.body: Jon still gets the OLD Magic Carpet at jalfern.com/retrogames/magic-carpet hours after #1059 deployed, even after a hard refresh. Same bug as #696, but #696 only fixed /retrogames/demos.

issues.title: DEMO — CORAL REEF: rebuild on the GPU (WebGL2 or WebGPU), from scratch
issues.body: Replaces #1038. Start fresh from main. Do not use the qa/coral-reef-1038 branch: it is Canvas 2D like the shipped reef, and Canvas 2D can't reach the bar.

issues.title: BLACK HOLE — make it spin (Qwen alone)
issues.body: Stretch experiment, goal only. Turn the black hole into a spinning one: the shadow goes lopsided (D-shaped), the disk is dragged around, and lensing changes to match. Keep it physically honest and smooth on iPhone. Qwen picks the approach; a toggle between spinning and non-spinning is welcome.
